topics.purpose: Define node-graph Elements with exact typed ports and validated edges so visual graph wiring projects canonical relation/composition semantics rather than inventing them.

semantics.node_rule: Each node represents an exact content/entity/operation/composition identity.
semantics.port_rule: Each input/output port has explicit identity/type/cardinality.
semantics.edge_rule: Connection references exact source output port and destination input port.
semantics.validation_rule: Edge type/cardinality compatibility validates before acceptance.
semantics.visual_rule: Node proximity/overlap never creates an edge.
semantics.semantic_rule: Graph engine owns node/port/edge structure; represented content keeps its semantic ownership.
semantics.authority_rule: Drawing an edge creates candidate relation/composition only until validated/applied.

invariants.rule: UI visibility, navigation, placement, styling, selection, focus and visual adjacency never create semantic ownership, resource identity or execution authority.
Effect-capable UI actions create explicit candidate/request data and must cross canonical validation, authorization and dispatcher boundaries before effects occur.

hard_gates.condition: drawing edge mutates live domain immediately
port labels used as type identity
